name: Muthoot Finance Ltd
title: Muthoot Finance Ltd - 533398 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Muthoot Finance Q4 FY26: gold AUM at record INR 1,65,000 crore and yields up ~50bp on pricing, but management gives no supply-side discipline signal and competition from new AAA-funded entrants is dismissed rather than quantified.

triggers.label: Rates raised 0.5-1% on some loans
triggers.quote: Last quarter, we increased our rates by about 0.5% to 1% over certain types of loans. So, that is why we see the yield has gone up.

triggers.label: New AAA-rated entrants with cheaper funds
triggers.quote: a bunch of all AAA rated NBFCs who are themselves deep pocketed, can raise liabilities at finer rat es than us.

triggers.label: Tonnage falling as gold prices rise
triggers.quote: whenever gold prices go up, the tonnage will come down.

triggers.label: Standalone AUM growth guide ~15%
triggers.quote: Always in the first quarter, we have always been giving a guidance of 15% only.

guidance.quote: Always in the first quarter, we have always been giving a guidance of 15% only.
This year, maybe 200-300 branches. That's it.
Belstar, we were thinking of opening another 200 branches or so

red_flags.label: Stage 3 and stage 2 rising; borrower-wise reclassification cited
red_flags.quote: the stage 3 increase has happened primarily because RBI has advised us to do a borrower wise classification.

red_flags.label: Customer count shrinking; ticket-size churn
red_flags.quote: we have lost about 15 lakh customers there. But we have added the same in the higher tickets

red_flags.label: Reluctance to share disbursement and yield detail
red_flags.quote: We do not want to get into the specifics of the yield increase.

evasions.quote: So, we don't want to give a view that the same rates will co ntinue.
Actually, why we want to go into all these details, sir?
I think that's a board decision and that company's individual decision, so let's leave it to them.
I do not have the numbers exactly. So, I will not be able to share right now.
